title: Jim Rider speech on devas, fairies and the veil thinning

tellings.quote: there's a speech that Jim Rider gives that's available online where he's talking about devas and fairies and jinn and he's talking about extrasensory perception and the veil thinning.

plain: An executive at Lockheed Martin Space Systems, the space arm of the big American defence company, named Jim Ryder gave a speech in which he talks about devas, fairies and jinn (spirit beings from various traditions), about extrasensory perception, and about "the veil thinning" between worlds. Jesse Michels mentions it himself, saying the speech is available online, as a sign that people deep in the aerospace industry take such ideas seriously.
